checks.name: paging under a type filter: first page + Load more equal the API listing order, no duplicates
arrivals while reading an older page: "New events available" shown; rows, scroll position and URL filter unchanged
Refresh: newest matching page replaces the rows (3 new alpha first, no beta), filter kept in URL and chip, notice cleared
paging after Refresh continues with the new cursor: exactly the API order, no duplicates or gaps
Refresh failure: rows and filters kept, failure explained; availability-check failure explained

detail.status:
Cannot reach the GraphGoblin API
The app keeps working with what it has; saving, running, and live updates resume when the API is reachable again. | Refresh failed. Your current events are still shown. Refresh to try again. Could not check for new events. Refresh to try again. | All events loaded.

checks.name: recovery: a later Refresh succeeds, clears the failure and brings the arrival in
Clear type filter: URL loses only type, focus moves to Refresh, unfiltered rows include other types
empty filtered result: explained; a first arrival is announced without inserting rows; Refresh shows it
before filter: chip shown, rows match the API, later events are not announced, Refresh keeps both filters
